title: Actionist donor token binding
description: One instance describes how ONE donor surface binds to the Actionist semantic token contract. The schema encodes P07's invariants as constraints rather than prose: encoding conversion is required when encodings differ, :root scoping is forbidden, a dark mirror is mandatory, and a cross-origin frame may not claim parity.
boundaries: research-only; no implementation, execution or admission authorized

binding_id.description: Stable identifier for this binding. One per donor SURFACE, not per donor -- a donor mounted two ways needs two bindings.

upstream.description: Canonical upstream repository or product URL.

version_pin.description: Exact commit, tag or release the binding was authored against. A binding is only valid for the pinned version.

token_system.description: The donor's own design-token system if it has one, e.g. 'shadcn/ui'. null when the donor is not token-driven.

variable_count.description: Number of donor variables enumerated from source. Required evidence for a B3 binding: an unenumerated donor cannot be bridged, only overridden.

binding_class.description: B1 native emission (owned) | B2 source extraction and retokenization | B3 scoped variable bridge | B4 scoped stylesheet override | B5 frame negotiation.

mount_topology.description: Structural fact determining which binding classes are physically available. iframe_cross_origin forces B5: custom properties do not inherit across an origin boundary.

coherence_ceiling.description: The honesty field. parity = visually indistinguishable from owned UI. high = bounded only by donor token coverage. bounded = same product, visibly different surface. none = donor renders in its own identity. A B5 binding may NOT declare parity.

selector.description: The container the binding is written to. :root and html are FORBIDDEN -- global injection leaks donor variable names into the whole host app and collides two namespaces silently.

applies_to.description: Human-readable description of the DOM subtree this binding governs.

single_seam.description: True when this binding is the ONLY place the donor's styling is defined. A donor with styling defined in more than one place is unauditable.

conversion.description: alias = donor variable set directly to host variable (ONLY legal when encodings are identical). convert = values transformed into the donor's encoding. authored = bridge values hand-authored in the donor's encoding. not_applicable = no variable-level binding (B5).

conversion_method.description: Named, pinned conversion. Required when conversion = convert.

alpha_preserved.description: Whether donor values carrying alpha retain it. Dropping alpha is a silent visual change.

then.description: INVARIANT I5: aliasing is only legal when host and donor encodings are identical. An aliased mismatch parses, renders, and is wrong -- only gate L catches it.

mappings.description: One entry per donor variable bound to a host role. Empty is legal ONLY for B5 (no variable-level binding is possible across an origin boundary).

donor_variable.description: The donor's own variable name, verbatim from donor source.

host_role.description: A role name from semantic-token-contract.json. Must be a family with donor_bindable = true.

mode_specific.description: Per-mode override where a single mapping is insufficient.

verified.description: observed = the donor variable was read from donor source. inferred = deduced from the donor's token system. unknown = assumed.

dark_mirror.description: Object rather than boolean: 'we have dark mode' is not a claim, a mirrored selector with measured coverage is.

selector.description: The dark-mode scope selector mirroring scope.selector.

coverage.description: donor_native = the donor switches its own dark theme by protocol rather than by inherited tokens (B5). This is a synchronization hazard under donor upgrade (U-F).

unstylable.description: Declared surfaces this binding CANNOT reach. An empty array on a B5 binding is suspicious by construction -- a cross-origin frame always has unreachable surfaces.

upgrade_fragility.description: stable = bound through the donor's own published token names. selector_coupled = depends on donor class names (B4). structure_coupled = depends on donor DOM shape. Consumed by S2-L3's upgrade replay model.

retokenization.description: B2 only. Records the extraction-time rewrite of donor literals to host roles.

failure_class.description: P05's taxonomy, adopted verbatim. webgl is NOT retokenizable by CSS -- colours live in shader uniforms.

source_available.description: False for compiled bundles. A bundle-only component cannot be retokenized at source.

review_required.description: True when machine rewrite is insufficient and a human must judge the result (U-B).

frame_negotiation.description: B5 only. What is achievable by protocol when no cascade crosses the boundary.

negotiated.description: What the host can influence. Note what is absent: per-role token parity is not negotiable.

mechanism.description: How donor chrome is hidden when framed. Precedent: data-* hide markers plus CSS injected only when framed.

retained.description: Donor chrome deliberately kept, e.g. a switcher the host has no replacement for.

escape_available.description: How this binding could escape the B5 ceiling if the ceiling proves unacceptable. same_origin_proxy is UNKNOWN in the estate (U-E); reuse_shape_change is proven but expensive.

gates.description: Which gates apply to this binding and their last recorded result. Source-literal gates B and J do not apply to B3/B4/B5.

evidence.description: Receipts. Every load-bearing claim in this binding traces to one.

receipt.description: Exact path, file:line, or URL. Required when state = observed.

sample_size.description: Required when the claim quotes a rate. A rate without its denominator is not evidence.

then.description: INVARIANT I6: a cross-origin frame cannot inherit custom properties, so it cannot reach parity. Declaring parity here is a false claim, not an ambitious one.
Structural consequence: no cascade crosses an origin boundary, therefore only B5 is physically available.
A bridge or override needs a real container scope and at least one mapping; otherwise it is an empty claim.
B4 couples the host to donor class names and DOM structure -- the surface with no stability contract. It cannot be stable by construction.

examples_note: Three worked instances -- one B3 (token-driven native mount), one B2 (component corpus), one B5 (cross-origin intact service) -- are carried in cross-donor-experiments.md rather than inlined here, so the schema stays the contract and the traces stay falsifiable.
